titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 46: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 46. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲙⲋ] (top left) is printed in restoration brackets with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke; the running title ⲛ[ⲕⲉⲫ]ⲁⲗⲁⲓⲟⲛ is partly restored, with a stroke over ⲛ. The whole line is 32 illegible dots (547–1370), many faint (area 1–5) but all visible at 4×. The dots of this page are printed faint: reconcile misses those of area < 6 (here 14) on ll. 1–6, 9, 12, 19, 29–33, and the dot rows of ll. 7, 8, 11, 25, 28 stand at the zone centre (top ≤ centre + 1), which it does not count; every dot was counted on the 4× sheets.

Two dots at the line start are followed by a closing bracket (≈583) with no opening bracket on this line or at the end of l. 1; the dots are encoded as illegible and the bracket as an unpaired sign (ledger §4).

Two dots before the bracket (547, 574), three after it (608, ≈635 faint, 662). Stroke over the first ⲙ of ⲙⲙⲁϩϯⲟⲩ (689–702). Diaeresis over ⲓ of ⲁϩ[ⲣ]ⲏⲓ (1069/1075). Dot under the second ⲁ of ⲁⲡⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ (1177); two illegible dots at the line end (1261, 1288).
As l. 2, two dots and a closing bracket (≈585) open the line with no opening bracket; unpaired sign. The bracket opened before the final ϥ is never closed; the restoration is closed at the line end.
The restored letter in ⲁⲣ[ⲉ]ⲧ[ϥ] is printed small and light (8×); read as ⲉ (cf. l. 4 ⲁⲣⲉⲧ[ϥ]).

Two dots before the bracket (548, 574), three after it (610–662), three after ⲃⲟ ⲛ (772–826), one inside [.] (861). Diaeresis over ⲓ of ⲡⲓⲱⲧ (965/970). Stroke over ⲛ of ⲛ[ⲧ]ⲱⲕ (1146–1158). Dot under ⲧ of ⲁⲣ[ⲉ]ⲧ (1328).

Two closing brackets with no opening bracket: after three dots at the line start (≈612) and before ⲧⲣⲉ (≈903). Both are encoded as unpaired signs; the dots are illegible and ⲧⲣⲉ is read (ledger §4). The bracket opened before the final ϥ is closed at the line end.

Three dots before the first bracket (548, 575, ≈604 against the bracket), ten between the brackets (637–875, faint). Dots under ⲧ and ⲉ of ⲧⲣⲉ (916, 945) and under ⲣ (left of the descender, 1318), ⲉ (1329), ⲧ (1345) of ⲁⲣⲉⲧ[ϥ]. Stroke over ⲛ of ⲛϭⲁⲙ (973–986). The strokes tool also reports the descender of ϣ of l. 3 (1056–1065).

Eleven dots inside the brackets (557–822; 743 and 822 too faint for the dots tool, visible at 4×). Dots under ϥ (left of the descender, 898), ⲡ of ϭⲱⲗⲡ (980), ⲉ of ⲡⲉ (1035), ⲱ and ⲩ of ⲁϫⲱⲩ (1259, 1277); two illegible dots (1063, 1090). The first ⲁ of ⲁⲃⲁⲗ is printed broken (stroke and a blob at mid-height, no bowl; 8×) and read as ⲁ; the blob is part of the letter, not a dot. No strokes.
Eleven dots and a closing bracket (≈826) open the line with no opening bracket; unpaired sign (ledger §4).

Eleven dots before the bracket (549–816, faint). Dots under ⲛ (871) and ϥ (886, left of the descender) of ⲛϥⲥⲁⲕⲟⲩ (8×). Measured stroke over ⲛϥ (872–888, pixel row): ⲛ 50 %, ϥ 50 %, encoded on both. Two dots inside [..] (1094, 1120), three after (1156–1210), three at the line end (1290–1344).

Eleven illegible dots at the line start (549–815; the second, ≈575, too faint for the dots tool, visible at 4×), six after ⲛϩⲏⲧϥ (1006–1138). Measured stroke over ⲛϥ (1253–1270, pixel row): ⲛ 53 %, ϥ 54 %, encoded on both.

Sixteen illegible dots at the line start (548–946). Dot under ϩ of ϩⲟⲩⲉ (969). Stroke over the first ⲙ of ⲙⲙⲁⲩ (1044–1057). Measured stroke over ⲛϥ of ⲛϥⲥⲉϩⲱⲟⲩ (1145–1161, pixel row): ⲛ 50 %, ϥ 54 %, encoded on both.
The restoration [ⲧⲟⲩ ...] holds restored letters and three dots (625–678) inside one pair of brackets.

Six illegible dots after the brackets (713–847). Strokes over ⲛ of ⲛϩⲏⲧϥ (873–885), over the final ϥ of ⲛϩⲏⲧϥ (944–955, a separate curved bar, 8×), over ⲛ of ⲛⲥⲉⲙⲟⲩⲛ (978–990), and over ⲁ of ϣⲁ (1224–1241, printed high, 14 px above the letter: ϣ 0 %, ⲁ 94 %). Dot under the final ⲛ of ⲛⲥⲉⲙⲟⲩⲛ (1076).
The edition prints brackets with blank space and no dots (548–842): a loss of uncounted extent.
"leer" after ϥ → vac.; ⲛ[ⲉⲓⲉ]ⲧϥ begins with an enlarged ⲛ in mid-line.

Three illegible dots after the brackets (865–918). Diaeresis over the restored ⲓ (1142/1147). Dots under ⲁ and ⲛ of ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲛ (1278, 1297), ⲓ (1345, at its foot) and ⲙ (1360) of ⲛⲓⲙ. No strokes; the strokes tool reports the descender of ϩ of l. 9 (891–902).
Eleven illegible dots at the line start (549–814, faint), seven after ⲛϥⲧⲉ (920–1079). Dot under the final ⲉ of ⲛⲧⲉ (1233). No strokes.

Illegible dots: four at the line start (548–626), three after ⲛⲧⲉ (718–770), three after ⲙ (837–890), two after ϩ (1032, 1059), one after ⲱ (1124), two inside [..] (1159, 1187), one after them (1222). No strokes; the strokes tool reports the descender of ϩ of l. 11 (1106–1120).
Kephalaion number ⲓⲇ (14), centred, with a bar over it (glyph y 798–819).

Title of kephalaion 14, ll. 14–15. The numeral ⲓⲇ is repeated in both margins, at the right in restoration brackets ([ⲓⲇ]); the glyphs (left y 862–883, centre 872; right 859–891) stand between l. 14 (centre 852) and l. 15 (centre 891) and are attached to l. 14 (ledger §4).

Stroke over the restored ⲙ (770–783; 65 %). Dots under ⲡ (804) and ⲣ (881, left of the descender) of [ⲙ]ⲡⲕ[ⲁ]ⲣⲁⲓⲧϥ, under ⲧ, ⲓ, ⲁ of ⲧⲛⲏⲥⲧⲓⲁ (1035, 1050, 1063). Diaeresis over ⲓ of ⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓⲧϥ (909/914). Reconcile also counts the feet of the marginal numerals (594, 610, 1226).

Measured stroke over the restored ⲙⲛ (794–812, pixel row): ⲙ 50 %, ⲛ 50 %, encoded on both. Stroke over ⲙ of ⲡⲙⲧⲁⲛ (877–886, pixel row; 48 % of the letter, the only letter under it, so encoded on ⲙ: a printed stroke is not dropped, ledger §3.17). Dots under ϫ (974) and ⲛ, ⲉ of ⲛⲉ (1125, 1139).
Line in ekthesis; the enlarged ⲡ is printed inside the restoration brackets.

Dots under ⲁ, ⲛ of ⲁⲛ (647, 666), ⲁ (701), ⲱ of ⲡⲫⲱ[ⲥ] (1023), ⲣ of ⲧⲏⲣ (1109, left of the descender), ⲉ, ⲩ of ⲡⲁϫⲉⲩ (1199, 1213). Dotted ϣ in ϣⲛ: a separate round dot in the lower bowl (923, 8×), unlike the undotted ϣ of ll. 5 and 9. No strokes.

Stroke over ⲙ of ⲙⲡϯⲟⲩ (716–728). Dots under ⲉ after [ⲥ] (872), the restored [ⲉ] (915), ⲧ of ⲉⲧ[ⲟ] (968), the final ⲟ of ⲟⲩⲧⲉⲟⲩⲟ (1094), ⲙ, ⲙ, ⲁ, ⲩ of ⲙⲙⲁⲩ (1129–1188) and ⲡ of ⲡ[ⲕⲟ] (1284). The strokes tool also reports the tail of ϣ of l. 16 (920–931). Reconcile counts the dot under the restored [ⲉ] (915), which the reading carries as a restored letter, so the image shows one more than the reading.

Dots under ⲙ of [ⲥ]ⲙⲟⲥ (586), ⲉ of ⲉⲩⲙⲟⲩ[ⲧ]ⲉ (765), ⲉ of ϫⲉ (816) and ⲏ of ϯⲣⲏⲛⲏ (1111); seven illegible dots (844–1002). No strokes; the strokes tool reports descenders of l. 17 (1225–1233, 1318–1326).

Dots under ⲕ (552), ⲓ (621, with a diaeresis 619/624) and ϥ (652, left of the descender, area 4, visible at 4×) of ⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓⲧϥ, under the final ⲉ of ⲉⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ (783) and ϫ of ϫⲉ (1082). Six dots inside the brackets (821–954). No strokes.
A bare opening bracket ends the line after ⲉⲕⲁⲧ, with nothing restored: a loss of uncounted extent to the line end.

Fourteen illegible dots at the line start (549–893). Stroke over the restored ⲛ of [ⲧⲛⲧⲱⲃϩ (947–959) and an oblique stroke over its ϩ (1022–1034, 8×). Diaeresis over ⲓ of ⲓⲱⲧ (1193/1198). Dot under ⲧ of ⲉⲕⲁⲧ (1355). The strokes tool also reports the descender of ϩ of l. 19 (1150–1159).
Ll. 21–24 carry the editors' statement "bis auf ganz geringe Spuren zerstört" under one brace; one statement per line (id destroyed-traces-faint).
Reconcile counts the umlaut and i-dots of the German statement (603–1080).
Twenty-three dots and a closing bracket (≈1157) with no opening bracket on this line or at the end of l. 24; the dots are illegible and the bracket an unpaired sign (ledger §4).
Twenty-three illegible dots (550–1130; 946 faint, area 1). Dot under the final ⲛ of ⲩⲛⲧⲉⲛ (1236). A speck above the dot row at x ≈ 872 is not a sign (not ink at the < 130 threshold). No strokes.
Ll. 26–27 carry the editors' statement "zerstört" under one brace; one statement per line.
Reconcile counts the umlaut and i-dots of the German statement (596–677).
Three illegible dots at the line start (550–603), three after ⲁ (665–718), nine at the line end (1072–1282). Dots under ⲧ and ⲁ of ⲛⲧⲁ (1021, 1040). No strokes.
Six illegible dots at the line start (550–682), three inside the brackets (1065–1118), four after them (1153–1233). Dots under the final ⲁ of ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ (1024) and the final ⲛ (1263). No strokes.
After one dot (983) the edition opens a bracket and prints seven dots (1019–1178) with no closing bracket; the gap is closed at the line end.
Dot under ⲧ of ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ (737). No strokes; the strokes tool reports the tail of ϣ of l. 29 (824–832).
The edition opens a bracket after ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ, prints ⲩⲛⲏ and five dots (1090–1197) with no closing bracket; letters and dots go into the restoration, closed at the line end (as 28.31).

Five illegible dots at the line start (550–657). Strokes over ⲙ of ⲙⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ (684–697) and ⲛ of ϩⲛ (836–848; ϩ not covered). Dots under the final ⲁ of ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ (785) and ⲟ, ⲩ of ⲟⲩⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ (872, 886). The ⲇ is the triangle form.
After three dots the edition opens a bracket and prints five dots (1077–1182) with no closing bracket; the gap is closed at the line end.

Four illegible dots at the line start (550–630), three after ⲙⲡ[ⲉⲁ]ⲩ (987–1039). Dots under ⲥ of ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗ[ⲟ]ⲥ (831), ⲡ of ⲙⲡ (886) and ⲩ after the brackets (954). No strokes; the strokes tool reports the descender of ϩ of l. 31 (820–829).
After ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ and three dots the edition opens a bracket and prints thirteen dots (876–1192) with no closing bracket; the gap is closed at the line end.
All ϣ on the page (ll. 3, 5, 9, 16, 29) were checked at 6–8×; only 16 (ϣⲛ) is dotted.
Four dots inside the first brackets (560–639), three after ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ (788–841). No strokes.
